title: Tailoring the ethanol selectivity of SnO2-based MEMS gas sensors via WO3-loading in double-pulse-driven mode
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48913-48922
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08502K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tao Ren, Koichi Suematsu, Yusuke Shimada, Yusuke Inomata, Tetsuya Kida, Ken Watanabe, Kengo Shimanoe
A highly selective ethanol sensor was achieved using WO3-loaded SnO2 under pulse heating mode. The strategy relies on pre-adsorption of ethanol at low temperatures, followed by rapid reaction during the heating pulse to generate a transient signal.
